title: Vol 7. The Pelican Guide to English Literature: The Modern Age

vibeProfile.oneLine: The Pelican Guide to the modern age.

summary: The seventh volume of Boris Ford's Pelican Guide to English Literature covers the Modern Age, the literature of the twentieth century. It surveys the modernists and their successors, from Eliot, Yeats, Joyce and Lawrence to later poets and novelists, with critical essays alongside a general account of the period. Accessible and influential, it brings the sometimes daunting literature of modern times within reach of students and general readers.
whyReadIt: The Pelican Guide's companion to twentieth-century literature. Modernism and after, made approachable.
